AggregationConcept.description: Concept on which the aggregation was performed, including the scope (entity type), property, and optional termIds or splits for selection or binning of the property values.

property.description: The property in th edata model on which the aggregation was performed.

scope.description: The scope (entity type) for the aggregation concept.

splits.description: Optional list of splits to group values for ranges or bins when performing the aggregation. TODO: Define types and/or couple them to property type.

termIds.description: Optional list of termIds to select specific values for aggregation.

AggregationObject.description: Aggregation object describing the count of one (or more, intersected) values for the concept(s) aggregated on.

conceptValues.description: List of ordered concept values (one per concept in `concepts`). These can represent values from the respected property or interpolations ( e.g. bins from splits).

count.description: Count of occurrences for this aggregation object in the matched data.

ConceptValue.description: A value or bin ... for the concept property.

id.description: Identifier for the concept value. This can be e.g. a term id, a split/bin range (e.g. '[P0D, P18M)'), or `undefined` for missing values.

label.description: Human readable label for the concept value.

AggregationResultsInstance.description: Summary data from results, with distributions of values (or value combinations) for one (or more) concepts. Each summary is identified by an `id`, `label`, `description`, and a list of one or more `concepts`. An an optional `sorted` property can indicate to the client that the returned `distribution` of the aggregation objects response has some pre-defined order. Each of the `concepts` describes the scope (entity; `individual`, `biosample` ...), the property aggregated on, and optional `termIds` or `splits` for selection or binning of the property values.

description.description: Description of the aggregation performed for this term.

distribution.description: A distribution contains a list of aggregation objects, where each describes the count of one (or more, intersected) values for the concept(s) aggregated on.

id.description: The id of the aggregation term being reported on.

label.description: The label of the aggregation term being reported on.

sorted.description: Indicates whether the distribution results are sorted in some way.
